# The spare key review

Mum still wants Lena to hold the spare key. The arrangement works because they see each other often, not because Lena promised to be permanently available. We wrote down who else could help during a holiday. [[Care arrangements]] needs consent renewed after a change of circumstances, without turning every friendly favour into paperwork.
